queries.workspace_project_lock: select "id" from "projects" where ("projects"."id" = $1 and "projects"."owner_id" = $2) for update
queries.workspace_rows: select "owner_id", "project_id", "workspace_id", "layout" from "workspace_layouts" where ("workspace_layouts"."owner_id" = $1 and "workspace_layouts"."project_id" = $2) order by "workspace_layouts"."workspace_id" asc for update
queries.layout_project_lock: select "id" from "projects" where "projects"."id" = $1 limit $2 for update
queries.member_select: select "tab_group_members"."tab_key", "tab_group_members"."group_id", "tab_group_members"."project_id", "tab_group_members"."tab_kind", "tab_group_members"."tab_id", "tab_group_members"."position", "tab_group_members"."created_at", "tab_group_members"."updated_at", "tab_groups"."id", "tab_groups"."project_id", "tab_groups"."protected_label", "tab_groups"."region", "tab_groups"."position", "tab_groups"."anchor_tab_key", "tab_groups"."created_at", "tab_groups"."updated_at" from "tab_group_members" inner join "tab_groups" on "tab_groups"."id" = "tab_group_members"."group_id" where ("tab_group_members"."project_id" = $1 and "tab_group_members"."tab_key" = $2) limit $3
queries.members_remaining: select "tab_key" from "tab_group_members" where "tab_group_members"."group_id" = $1 order by "tab_group_members"."position" asc, "tab_group_members"."tab_key" asc
queries.groups_remaining: select "id" from "tab_groups" where ("tab_groups"."project_id" = $1 and "tab_groups"."region" = $2) order by "tab_groups"."position" asc, "tab_groups"."id" asc
